statement.p: Nathan earned {\$119.51} of interest from a mutual fund, which was 0.37\% of his total investment. How much money did Nathan invest into this mutual fund?
Nathan invested in this mutual fund.

solution.p: This problem can be boiled down to this question: 119.51 is 0.37\% of what? We will show multiple methods to solve this problem.
We will use proportion to solve this problem. Assume 119.51 is 0.37\% of x, so 0.37 out of 100 corresponds to 119.51 out of x.
We will write and solve the proportion:
Nathan invested {\$32{,}300.00} in this mutual fund.
We will use the percentage formula to solve this problem. This translation from English to math may help you remember the percentage formula.
The question is: 119.51 is 0.37\% of what? Assume 119.51 is 0.37\% of x. We have:
Nathan invested {\$32{,}300.00} in this mutual fund.
In the sentence 119.51 is 0.37\% of what,

li.p: what is the base (following the word of).

solution.p: By the formula \text{base} = \frac{\text{percentage}}{\text{rate}}, we do a division to solve the problem:
Nathan invested {\$32{,}300.00} in this mutual fund.
